    """ Mathematical function for acceleration in a damped nonlinear oscillator

    """
    k = params[0]  # Linear stiffness coefficient
    nonlin_coeff = params[1]  # Coefficient for nonlinear term

    driving_force_amplitude = params[5]  # Amplitude of the driving force
    driving_force_frequency = params[6]  # Frequency of the driving force
    energy_well_depth = params[7]  # Energy well depth
    energy_well_width = params[8]  # Energy well width
    energy_well_center = params[9]  # Energy well center position
